errors.evidence: The categories on the y-axis are not sorted alphabetically. They are sorted in descending order of value, with some minor exceptions.
The value for "Mindestlohnbetriebe" in the category "Höhere Kosten Energie/Treibstoffe" is approximately 95%, not 93% as stated.
The description completely omits the data for the category "Probleme mit Lieferanten/Logistik", which is the third category from the top with values between 62% and 68%.

errors.evidence: For the category "Einschränkung/Verlust Geschäftsbeziehungen", the values for the two groups are swapped. The light blue bar ("Mindestlohnbetriebe") is longer (~25%) than the dark blue bar ("übrige Betriebe", ~23%), but the description states the opposite (23% vs 24%).
The categories are sorted in descending order based on the values for "Mindestlohnbetriebe". Stating they are unsorted is incorrect.
